weather.quip: Open-Meteo has Mill Valley starting Tuesday at 55°, feeling like 53°, foggy, 100% humid, and breezy from the west-southwest around 9 mph. The local forecast tops out near 70° with about 1% rain odds, UV around 7.6, sunrise at 6:22 AM, and sunset at 8:08 PM. wttr agrees on the 55° foggy start but runs much warmer later, so this is another classic Mill Valley microclimate day: trust the fog now, keep layers flexible later.

ideas.title: Treat the haircut like the morning anchor

ideas.title: Use the fog layer while it is useful
ideas.description: A 55° foggy start is friendly for a walk, errand, or garage poke-around before the afternoon gets brighter and breezier.

ideas.title: Pick one boring dragon

ideas.title: Stage Friday orientation early

ideas.title: Do the sunscreen anyway
ideas.description: Fog is not a legally binding contract. UV near 7.6 means sunscreen belongs in the plot even if the morning looks harmless.

ideas.title: Rockets break with a timer
ideas.description: Five minutes of offseason reading is medicinal. The trade machine after minute fifteen starts billing as a hobby.
